call_points.text: Management reaffirmed target of achieving 1 million laden TEUs in FY28 and 12.5-13 lakh TEUs capacity by FY30.
Farrukhnagar PFT completion is scheduled for April 2027, with the ICD facility expected two quarters later.
Annual cash lease outgo for FY27 is estimated between ₹95 Cr and ₹100 Cr following lease extensions.
Ground rent has declined to approximately 20% of CFS revenue as handling and value-added services expand.
Facing temporary terminal congestion and transport fleet shortages at JNPT, though management views these as seasonal.

tax_litigation.status: The Company and its subsidiary (Speedy Multimodes Limited) received an assessment order under Section 158BC of the Income-tax Act, 1961 for the block period from 01.04.2018 to 05.04.2025. Pursuant to the said order, tax demand raised is as mentioned below: Allcargo Terminal limited- Rs.49,34,89,246/- Speedy Multimodes Limited (Material Unlisted WOS)- Rs. 3,69,00,075/- Total Rs. 53,03,89,321/- Out of the total demand of Rs. 53,03,89,321/-, an amount of Rs. 49,12,94,793/- pertains to the disallowance of deduction claimed under Section 80IA of the Income-tax Act, 1961 for Assessment Years 2023-24 to 2025-26. The issue involved relates to a long-standing interpretational matter concerning the eligibility of deduction in respect of the Company’s CFS business undertaking. Similar issues arising in earlier years in the case of the predecessor entity have been adjudicated favourably at the appellate stages, including relief granted by the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). The Company is of the view that the deduction claimed is in accordance with the applicable provisions of law and is duly supported by judicial precedents. Accordingly, the Company is pursuing appropriate legal remedies. In respect of the balance demand amounting to Rs. 3,90,94,527/-, the Company is in the process of examining the order in detail and shall pursue such legal remedies as may be considered appropriate. The aforesaid matter does not have any impact on the operations, business continuity, or underlying financial position of the Company

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The litigation pertaining to the aforesaid matter remains unchanged as per the last disclosure filed on June 2026 quarter

guidance.statement: Targeting 1 million laden TEUs in FY28 and capacity of 12.5-13 lakh laden TEUs by FY30
Capex spend of ₹400 Cr planned across Farrukhnagar, JNPT Speedy, Mundra, and Chennai expansions

industry: Services > Transport Infrastructure > Port & Port services

operating_notes.text: Issued 3,97,98,999 partly paid-up equity shares at ₹20 per share on rights basis (₹5 paid up on application).
Received Income Tax demand of ₹53.04 Cr (₹49.35 Cr for ATL and ₹3.69 Cr for Speedy Multimodes) for block period 01.04.2018 to 05.04.2025.
Total volumes in April 2026 stood at 59.2 thousand TEUs, higher by 7% YoY and 1% MoM.
Company estimates CFS market share at 10-12% across ports addressing 80-85% of India's EXIM trade.
Ground rent has moderated to ~20% of CFS revenue, shifting mix toward cargo handling and value-added logistics services.
Speedy facility at JNPT secured a 10-year contract extension, with ₹20 Cr yard and warehouse upgrades underway.
Board approved seeking shareholder ratification for FY24-25 material related party transactions with Allcargo Logistics.

timeline.summary: Allcargo Terminals filed CRISIL's monitoring agency report confirming utilisation of ₹14.92 Cr from its ₹79.60 Cr Rights Issue during Q4FY26 without deviation.
Allcargo Terminals received a ₹53.04 Cr Income Tax demand notice under Section 156 for block period FY19 to FY25.
Allcargo Terminals reported total volumes of 59.2 thousand TEUs for April 2026, up 7% YoY.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹208.04 Cr, net profit ₹8.77 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.42 Cr a year earlier).
Allcargo Terminals filed its statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 for Q4FY26 showing no deviation in fund utilization.
Allcargo Terminals reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹208 Cr and PAT of ₹9 Cr.
Allcargo Terminals Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4 & FY 2025-26, held May 22, 2026, via its website.
Allcargo Terminals held its Q4FY26 earnings call, detailing a ₹400 Cr 3-year capex plan and reiterating its 1 million TEU volume target by FY28.
Allcargo Terminals' board approved seeking shareholder ratification for FY25 material RPTs with Allcargo Logistics.
